rationale: Amino acid fermentation is my primary strategy: branched-chain and aromatic amino acids provide both carbon and nitrogen. Acetate and butyrate supplement carbon. Fermentation products (acetate, CO₂, H₂) balance redox and mass. Growth is limited by available nitrogen from amino acids (~2 mmol/gDW/h available, supporting ~0.2 /h). This is realistic for the final 8 hours of a sealed batch.
